note.note:
I’m missing the actual content to generate the SOAP note.

Please provide:
- The transcript text (doctor-patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format

Notes:
- Do not include any data not present in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If the transcript and DDx conflict, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”

Once you share the transcript and DDx, I will produce a concise, professional SOAP note with:
- Subjective: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, social history
- Objective: physical findings and/or relevant exam details (if provided)
- Assessment & Plan: up to multiple issues, each with:
  - Likely diagnosis (name)
  - DDx (only when consistent with transcript)
  - Investigations, treatments, and referrals (as applicable)
- Quality checks: note any missing elements, internal conflicts, or transcript quality concerns
